facts.fact: 前一日袭击的伤亡传遍城堡：Gabriel麾下21名士兵和9名平民丧生，死者几乎全是angheals，贵族们把猜测与传言当作谈资。
facts.anchor: Twenty-one of Gabriel’s soldiers lost their lives, as did nine civilians.

facts.fact: Aurora回城途中昏迷，Darragh把她送到首席治疗师——daemonite族美人Thrissa处，治好严重脑震荡并留观数小时；Thrissa第一小时就赶走Darragh，他离开时衬衫被Aurora靠出的血浸湿。
facts.anchor: I did black out on the way back to the castle, but Darragh got me to the lead healer, a beautiful daemonite named Thrissa, who healed my bad concussion but kept me for a few hours of observation.

facts.fact: Cora每隔一天就与Queen Mollah一起为舞会出主意；Mollah告知Cora、Percie、Sellen三个孩子只能参加舞会前半段（酒和跳舞会让大人举止失态）；Cora穿淡紫绣金鸽的裙子，与Percie王子的tunic成套。
facts.anchor: Queen Mollah broke the news to her that younglings, Cora, Percie, and Sellen, were only able to stay for the early portion of the event.

facts.fact: Gabriel质问Aurora为何没穿他送上房间的裙子，Aurora谎称裙子穿上时裂了——实则她拒穿那件亮粉色深V亮片长裙，改穿她原在Rosalyn裙店看中没买、竟随Anya送来的裙子一起到且完全合身的深酒红缎裙（水晶装饰、中腿开衩）。
facts.anchor: “Yes, Your Highness. The dress ripped when I put it on. I had to be resourceful and wear this one. My apologies.”

facts.fact: 一名seraph贵族（Aurora记不清是Gostrin还是Gisler）跪到Cora面前、贴近到几英寸，暗示她与Percie王子是一对；Aurora立刻挡在女儿身前怒视——她幼年也被贵族这样撮合而母亲还鼓励，她绝不容忍。
facts.anchor: “Cora, I have heard so much about you! What a lovely pair you make with Prince Percie.”

facts.fact: 舞池上Gabriel贴耳说Aurora今晚让他疯狂、想象她褪去缎衣的曲线；Aurora称还没准备好那种亲密，Gabriel却说他昨天听到她在浴缸里、还闻到她的情动——而她当时幻想的对象正是Gabriel憎恨的人。
facts.anchor: “You feel the same, don’t you? I heard you in the bathtub yesterday. I could smell your arousal,” he hummed.

facts.fact: Aurora在角落向Darragh补讲没说完的事：Gabriel办公室有一本书脊写着‘MEAD’的书，Gabriel自称从西谷带回的民兵身上搜得；她怀疑与Psilas有关（西方有人类出没的传闻）。
facts.anchor: A book in Gabriel’s office. ‘MEAD’ was written on the spine. Gabriel said he took it off one of the militia members he brought in from the west valley.

facts.fact: Darragh认为时间点可疑，疑惑Lyrik为何以为那本书十多年前已毁于火灾，答应去查；并说今晚本就要为Aurora父亲的戒指去找Gabriel谈——而Gabriel早餐上对此与赎罪之事绝口不提。
facts.anchor: The timing of it is suspicious, but I wonder why Lyrik would think it had burned in a fire over a decade ago. I’ll check into it. I was going to talk to Gabriel tonight about your father’s ring anyway.

facts.fact: Aurora主动邀Darragh共舞（Gabriel刚被报信的士兵叫走）；转到外侧时她撞进Gabriel怀里被牢牢揽住，Gabriel杀气腾腾盯住Darragh——Aurora按住他胸口谎称要谈“我们的事”把他引出舞厅，让Darragh脱身。
facts.anchor: As Darragh turned me outward again, I collided with a chest of blue and gold. Arms wrapped around me, pulling me in firmly. Possessively.
